actions.name: Ethereal Body
actions.description: As a standard action, the mech's molecular structure becomes slightly intangible. It's treated as incorporeal for the purpose of taking damage until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Ghost Shift
actions.description: As a move action, the mech passes through a solid object or surface of a thickness no more than 1 foot per its mech tier, emerging on the other side. If the object is too thick, the mech is shunted back where it began and takes 1d6 damage per foot of surface above its tier.

description.value:
A frame with a pale white color and translucent appearance, ideal for reconnaissance.

@PPAbility[cost:2]{Ethereal Body} Become incorporeal for damage purposes until the end of your next turn.

@PPAbility[cost:3]{Ghost Shift} Pass through solid objects up to 1 foot thick per mech tier.

A mech can have only one starmetal frame system.
